title: Lekalo Search Diagnostic Set
description: Closed producer snapshot of one admitted diagnostic set (dev.lekalo.search-diagnostics@0.8.0, wire lekalo/search-diagnostics/v0.8.0). A search input manifest admits this document by kind `diagnostics`; the runtime decoder enforces exactly this closed grammar member for member (required members, no unknown members at any depth, closed severity/disposition vocabularies, per-member bounds, and the metadata count cross-check), and additionally refuses findings whose subject names no real card of the admitted projection and findings that reuse one id with a conflicting rule or subject. Documents are exact UTF-8 JSON with no duplicate keys.

project.description: The project this diagnostic set is scoped to; a foreign project never joins another project's view.

findingCount.description: Must equal the number of carried findings exactly (a spliced snapshot refuses).

id.description: The stable finding identity; one id may carry only one (rule, subject) pair — a disagreeing reuse is an identity conflict refused at admission.

rule.description: The exact registered diagnostic rule id (at least two dot-separated lowercase segments).

subject.description: The semantic id of the finding's subject; must name a real card of the admitted projection (ghost subjects refuse at admission).

disposition.description: A resolved finding stays visibly stale (excluded by default, retained under --include-stale), never erased.
